Description
This coin was originally released in 1997, and has been in high demand ever since. This coin has one of the most incredible designs that have ever been on a gold coin in the nation. It features a leaping kangaroo on a sunburst-like design of gold on the obverse. This side of the coin also shows the .9999 purity and the amount of gold in each coin. On the reverse side of the coin, Queen Elizabeth II is shown in relief, with her face being outlined by the pure and brilliant gold. Although it is listed as being worth 25 dollars, one will never spend this coin because of its worth on the gold market.
This coin is very appealing to people who want to invest in gold because it gives them the opportunity to buy a fair amount of gold over time in increments. Gold is one of the best commodities to invest in right now, as the price keeps going up in favor of the investor. Also, since it is one of the most easily-traded goods in the world, you will always be able to find some currency to convert your gold into if needed.
